title.narrative: Agriculture Sector Recovery in Türkiye's Earthquake-affected Provinces

description.narrative: The project will provide US$250 million in financing to the Government of Turkiye (GoT) to support agriculture sector recovery and reconstruction while building the resilience of the sector. This will have benefits for farming communities, businesses, consumers, and the environment. The proposed project aims to support short-term economic recovery and address more mid-term recovery and reconstruction needs of the agri-food subsector. Project investments are intended to contribute to restoring agriculture supply chain flows in the earthquake-affected provinces by ensuring continued and enhanced access by farmers and agribusinesses to key services and through rebuilding assets. It will promote mid- to longer-term rebound and recovery, focusing on higher agriculture's climate resilience, inclusiveness, and environmentally and socially sustainability.
The Project Development Objective is to support the resilient recovery of the agriculture sector in Turkiye's earthquake-affected provinces and targeted adjacent areas.

title.narrative: Area provided with new/improved irrigation or drainage services

comment.narrative: As of 05-May-2026, no area has been provided with new or improved irrigation/drainage services, as investments are at the pre-construction stage. Feasibility studies and detailed designs are being procured (tender launched in early April 2026), which will define investment sites and implementation schedules. Area-based progress will be reported once works begin and are verified.

As of 05-May-2026, no irrigation efficiency gains have been recorded because irrigation investments are in the design and procurement preparation phase. The tender for feasibility studies and detailed designs for the first set of cooperatives was launched in early April 2026. Baseline and post-investment measurements will be taken once works are completed and commissioned; progress will be reported in subsequent ISRs.

title.narrative: Grievances addressed by the project in accordance with the stipulated service standards

comment.narrative: As of 05-May-2026, no project grievances have been recorded for resolution, as project activities are still commencing. The Grievance Mechanism is established and accessible through multiple channels; any cases received will be logged and resolved in line with service standards. Reporting against this indicator will begin once cases are received and processed.

title.narrative: Area under improved climate adaptation management

comment.narrative: As of 05-May-2026, no project-financed adaptation management practices have been implemented, as field activities are at an early stage and procurement is ongoing. Implementation is expected to start under SC2.2 (sustainable pasture management) once contracts are awarded and mobilized in 2026. Progress will be reported in the next ISR based on verified implementation records from beneficiary sites.

title.narrative: Farmers trained in the application of climate-smart livestock practices

comment.narrative: As of 05-May-2026, no training has been reported under this indicator, as the livestock grant program (SC2.1) is being prepared and SC2.2 activities are at an early mobilization stage. Training plans and delivery modalities will be finalized as implementation support is mobilized in 2026. The first training sessions and participant records are expected to be reported in the next ISR.

title.narrative: Pasture management plans implemented with community involvement

comment.narrative: As of 05-May-2026, pasture management plans have been prepared under the national program and implementation is progressing on the ground; however, project reporting for this indicator will start once implementation supported by the project is verified and documented. The team will align the monitoring approach (what constitutes “implemented” and evidence requirements) and report verified implementation progress in the next ISR.

title.narrative: Project beneficiaries reporting that the project has established effective citizen engagement processes/ tools

comment.narrative: As of 05-May-2026, project-specific citizen engagement tools have not yet been rolled out, as field implementation is just starting. The Grievance Mechanism is in place and outreach/awareness activities have been conducted. Citizen feedback tools (e.g., SMS/web-based questionnaires) will be designed and deployed as beneficiary-facing activities scale up in 2026, with reporting expected in subsequent ISRs.

title.narrative: Pasture information system upgraded and fully operational

comment.narrative: As of 05-May-2026, the pasture information system upgrade has not started. Preparatory technical discussions have been undertaken to define scope and requirements, and Terms of Reference for detailed scoping are under preparation with Bank input. The next milestone is finalization of the Terms of Reference and launch of the related assignment in 2026; progress will be reported in subsequent ISRs.

title.narrative: Project Monitoring Information System developed and operational

comment.narrative: As of 05-May-2026, the project monitoring information system has not yet been developed, reflecting pending mobilization of dedicated M&E capacity and implementation support. Interim arrangements are in place to maintain basic reporting, and the Ministry is expected to assign dedicated M&E resources to operationalize the system. The next milestone is agreement on system requirements and an implementation plan in 2026; progress will be reported in the next ISR.

title.narrative: Farmers trained in the application of climate-smart livestock practices

comment.narrative: The indicator measures the number of farmers that are reached with training programs on a range of climate-livestock practices, under subcomponent 2.1 and 2.2 activities.

title.narrative: Area under improved climate adaptation management

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the area of crops and pastures where adaptation management practices have been applied (improved irrigation systems, sustainable pasture management and soil preparation under conservation approaches)

title.narrative: Project beneficiaries reporting that the project has established effective citizen engagement processes/ tools

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the effectiveness of citizen engagement process throughout the project cycle (through SMS/ web-based questionnaires)

title.narrative: Project Monitoring Information System developed and operational

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the implementation of a monitoring and evaluation system to manage all information related to the project. This system will have a digital platform to manage all project information.

title.narrative: Grievances addressed by the project in accordance with the stipulated service standards

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the percentage of grievances addressed and responded by the project in accordance with stipulated service standards.

title.narrative: Area provided with new/improved irrigation or drainage services

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the total area of land provided with irrigation and drainage services under the project, including in (i) the area provided with new irrigation and drainage services, and (ii) the area provided with improved irrigation and drainage services, expressed in hectare (ha).

title.narrative: Pasture information system upgraded and fully operational

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the upgrade and operationalization of an information and monitoring system on pastures using up to date digital technologies.

This indicator refers to the increase in irrigation efficiency realized by the reduction of conveyance losses by use of modern irrigation methods based on closed rather than open channel methods. It is estimated as the water used as percentage of the water delivered. Values and targets refer to efficiency increase, in absolute percentage points from baseline, averaged over project investments.
